name: tr_poeltl
caption:
IF POELTL WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🌲 Snover, the pioneer: from Vienna, the first Austrian ever drafted
🦴 Marowak, the boomerang: traded for Kawhi, back with us in 2023
🧊 Avalugg, the wall: 6 blocks and 30 points days after coming home
🥋 Hariyama, the finisher: 70.0% from the field last season
🟣 Swalot, the glass eater: 19 points and 11 rebounds at Milwaukee
🦖 Tyranitar, the ace: our big man, career-best 14.5 points a night in 2024-25

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Pöltl was born in Vienna; June 23, 2016 selected by Toronto with the ninth overall pick (#9, pick 9), the first Austrian drafted to the NBA; traded with DeRozan to San Antonio for Kawhi Leonard in July 2018; traded back to the Raptors on February 9, 2023; February 14, 2023: 30 points, nine rebounds and 6 (six) blocks in a 133-123 win over the Orlando Magic
